topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I was scrolling through the admissions website, looking for tips, perhaps some hints on what they’re looking for in a standout essay, and there it was—my words, my thoughts, neatly laid out as an example of what to write. My hands trembled a little as I skimmed through the paragraphs I’d poured my heart into. It’s strange, seeing your words displayed like that, open for everyone to critique. I hadn’t considered this possibility, and now I wondered how many eyes have already read my story, what they might think of it. I took a deep breath, trying to steady myself, but the thought of those words, so personal, being dissected by strangers lingered, leaving an uncomfortable tightness in my chest.
